historical_record.description: Grace Cathedral, picketed on 26 September 1965 by about thirty demonstrators protesting the Episcopal Diocese's curtailment of a canon's duties over his support for gay and lesbian rights; in 1976 it hosted part of the Conference on Violence Against Women.
